scope: Independent mathematical and literal-contract review of AMD1-AMD9. The later AMD10-AMD17 measure assembly is outside this focused review; no Bessel or Siegel-Weil producer is inferred.
findings: AMD1: The trace-zero quadratic basis gives a continuous algebra isomorphism on the original moduleTopology tensor model, both scalar projections and every chosen archimedean embedding; its coordinate equations preserve involution and the polynomial unitary inverse, including rank zero.

AMD2: The supplied P_v convention is the correct conjugation orientation. The same principal-congruence subgroups are a cofinal basis for both the declared I.Gf topology and the restricted-product topology. The two scalar projections determine every entry, so every supplied bridge witness is the constructed bridge.

AMD3: Exact rational matrices are retained. Opposite-sign zero entries are equivalent to preserving the literal majorant (P_v^-1)^*P_v^-1. The finite global-lattice span agrees with its completed local lattices, so the original Kset, not a conjugate compact, is carried to KfHA.

AMD4: Compared directly against Frame.IsStd, Ssub=uniFlag(F0), Hsub=stabT(tupH), and generic Nsub. The Nsub condition tests every vector of U-perp modulo U and is not replaced by FrameUnipotentSubgroup. Fixed direct summands make the universal condition finite and closed; both scalar projections preserve it.

AMD5: The quotient U-perp/U is V0. An element of S fixes z in that quotient and induces precisely U(W); its kernel is the full generic N. The inverse factorization is s -> (s*j(q(s))^-1,j(q(s))), with no positive-definiteness premise. The reported double-comma typo is corrected in the bound text.

AMD6: The nilpotent Lie blocks have C skew-Hermitian and the stated dual B block. Finite exp/log is valid in characteristic zero. The H-conjugation determinant on the r copies of W-dual is Norm_E/F(det_E h)^(-r)=1, at every finite place including split and residue characteristic two. The restricted-product argument preserves these exact local moduli; noncompact H is covered.

AMD7: Left multiplication in N semidirect H uses the H-conjugation just proved measure-preserving. Multiplication is a homeomorphism, so its product pushforward is nonzero Radon Haar. The ambient equality is literal pushforward functoriality and introduces no scalar normalization.

AMD8: The source weak predicate has exactly sigma-finiteness, nonzero measure, support and left-translation invariance. Both Tonelli identities are valid before local finiteness, using unimodularity for right/inversion invariance. A finite positive nu-set and compact finite positive Haar-set force both remaining factors finite and positive, and hence nu=c*Haar with 0<c<infinity. No regularity assumption is added.

AMD9: Original InS/InN/Hset conditions match AMD4 under the exact given bridge. The z-condition in InN is redundant for a standard frame because z lies in U-perp. Applying AMD8 to the supplied ambient measures gives exactly the two Haar measures and original pushforward equalities required by InfTransfer.
